string-array.name: list_child
string-array.item: CPU - Central Processing Unit (Main processor of a computer)
GPU - Graphics Processing Unit (Handles graphics and image processing)
RAM - Random Access Memory (Temporary memory for fast data access)
ROM - Read Only Memory (Permanent memory, only readable)
HDD - Hard Disk Drive (Traditional disk-based data storage)
SSD - Solid State Drive (Modern and faster data storage)
DVD - Digital Versatile Disc (Optical disc for video and data storage)
USB - Universal Serial Bus (Used for data transfer and device connection)
LAN - Local Area Network (Small network within limited area)
WAN - Wide Area Network (Large-scale wide coverage network)
IP - Internet Protocol (Address for devices in a network)
MAC - Media Access Control (Unique hardware address of a device)
HTTP - HyperText Transfer Protocol (Protocol for loading web pages)
HTML - HyperText Markup Language (Language for creating web pages)
CSS - Cascading Style Sheets (For styling and designing web pages)
SQL - Structured Query Language (Used for managing databases)
API - Application Programming Interface (Allows apps to communicate)
AI - Artificial Intelligence (Technology mimicking human intelligence)
IoT - Internet of Things (Smart devices connected to the internet)
BIOS - Basic Input Output System (Startup software of a computer)
OS - Operating System (Core software to run a computer/mobile)
DNS - Domain Name System (Converts domain names into IP addresses)
VPN - Virtual Private Network (Secure private network connection)
SMS - Short Message Service (Text messaging service)
MMS - Multimedia Messaging Service (Messaging with images/videos)
ISP - Internet Service Provider (Company that provides internet)
URL - Uniform Resource Locator (Address of a web page)
PDF - Portable Document Format (Document file format for sharing)
ZIP - Compressed File Format (Stores multiple files in smaller size)
XML - eXtensible Markup Language (Language for storing and sharing data)
JSON - JavaScript Object Notation (Lightweight data exchange format)
IDE - Integrated Development Environment (Tools for programming)
SDK - Software Development Kit (Collection of tools for app development)
UI - User Interface (Visible part of app/website for users)
UX - User Experience (Overall experience of the user)
